_doc: Entitlement-tier classification manifest (D1/D2/D3 ADR-COCKPIT-GLOBAL-SKILLS-PROVISIONING). Metadata-only — never adds a tier field to any SKILL.md frontmatter. tier: base = free, never paywalled, materializes unconditionally. tier: pack:sinkra-os = the sinkra-os process/methodology set (ADR D1, founder amendment 2026-07-19 'sinkra-os ainda não vai para todos'): materializes ONLY under entitlements[sinkra-os] at ANY tier (mapear|forjar — exact-match strings, forjar strictly supersets mapear per the hub tier-manifest/ADR-COCKPIT-PROTECTED-BUNDLE-DELIVERY). Sub-tier tags pack:sinkra-os:mapear / pack:sinkra-os:forjar are SUPPORTED by the gate (029.W1.3, hub advisory Gap 2) for tier-partitioned content; no dir carries them today — the forge-only skills (sinkra-create-skill*) live in the hub npm channel, NOT in this bundle (hub advisory Gap 3: never re-tag/copy the npm-curated set here — that would be the delivery-channel split ADR-COCKPIT-ENTERPRISE-PREMIUM-PACK D3-D9 still has in DRAFT).
_doc2: Taxonomy correction (founder 2026-07-22, supersedes the 2026-07-21 D-quais refinement's premium split): the SDC kit — governance (adr/governance-pipeline/roundtable/advisory-council), execution (wave-execute/full-cycle), story lifecycle (validate/develop/review/apply-qa-fixes/close/push/deploy/verify), design & UI (design-system/design-chief/frontend-builder/aiox-ux-designer/impeccable + ds-*) — is AIOX COCKPIT product and ships as tier base to every active cockpit user. pack:sinkra-os is reserved EXCLUSIVELY for the SINKRA OS process-mapping family (/sinkra-pipeline, /sinkra-create-skill + satellites), which is delivered via the hub npm channel (npx sinkra-os install), NOT embedded in this bundle — as of v1.3.0 ZERO embedded skills carry the tag; the gate machinery (029.W1.3) stays in place for future pack content. The D1 amendment 'sinkra-os ainda nao vai para todos' remains in force for that family. criar-sot + tech-search promotion note (2026-07-21) unchanged.
